description:
We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm 

 Hello! We are GoFasti, a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe. 

 We need an English-proficient AI Engineer , based in Latin America, available to work remotely.

We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills.
 Are you the one we are looking for?
 Responsibilities: 
 Design, build, and deploy AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Claude (Anthropic), or apply ML experience to similar enterprise use cases

 Implement RAG applications using vector databases (such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, Chroma) with support from senior team members — including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation

 Help configure deployments to meet enterprise requirements for data isolation, security, and governance, collaborating with team leads as needed

 Work with business, data, and product teams to turn requirements into practical AI agent or RAG/ML solutions

 Support management of the data layer—databases and pipelines—underlying agents and RAG/ML applications

 Contribute to designing and integrating AI/ML-enabled business processes throughout development and deployment

 Where appropriate, assist with automation (RPA), machine learning, and front-end delivery workstreams

 Help integrate AI/ML solutions with internal systems, APIs, workflow engines, data sources, and business applications to enable end-to-end business processes

 Requirements: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (required)

 3+ years’ experience in AI agent development OR machine learning solution development, with exposure to enterprise AI platforms (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, Anthropic, or comparable ML platforms)

 Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or hands-on ML engineering involving vector databases, embeddings, or similar technologies

 Experience managing or supporting data pipelines and databases

 Familiarity with designing workflow-driven agents or ML models that interact with APIs or enterprise systems

 Experience with REST APIs and basic integration engineering preferred

 Practical knowledge of Python for data processing, automation, and AI/ML solution development

 Understanding of software development lifecycle practices (Git, CI/CD, automated testing, security best practices)

 Advanced English to collaborate with U.S.-based teams

 It's a plus: 
 Experience working with cloud environments (Azure preferred) is a plus

 Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, web-based front-end frameworks (Angular, React), and agent/orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, etc.) is a plus

 Compensation: 
 The salary range offered for this position varies from (USD) $3,500 - $4,000 per month, depending on seniority and skillset.

 This position is for a full time contract, through a payroll platform.

 The talent will work remotely allocated at our client.

 Here are the steps for this process: 

Application review/approval > Screening interview with GoFasti's team > We build and send your profile to our client > Profile review/approval by client > Interview with the client > Hiring and onboarding.
 Once you apply for the job, our team will review your resume. If it meets the requirements, we will contact you and move forward in the process. 

 Note for Candidates Approached Directly: 
If you were contacted directly by a member of our team and are interested in this opportunity, please do not apply through this link. Instead, reach out to the person who contacted you to coordinate a meeting. 

Thank you!
